title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
statement: The tree is a valid BST. Return its kth smallest value, counting from 1.
hints: An in-order traversal of a BST visits values in ascending order. That is the entire insight.
So you want the kth node produced by an in-order walk.
Rather than collecting everything, count as you go and stop at k. An explicit stack lets you bail out early without unwinding recursion.
